title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Duty to the Court - Misleading Citations
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities
topic: Duty to the Court - Misleading Citations

questions.q: In written submissions to the LTB, a paralegal knowingly cites a section of the Residential Tenancies Act that was entirely repealed two years ago, hoping the adjudicator will not verify it. What ethical breach has occurred?
options: Misleading the tribunal and breach of the duty of candour.
questions.explain: Rule 2.01 (Duty to the Administration of Justice). A paralegal must not knowingly attempt to deceive a tribunal by offering false evidence, misstating facts, or citing repealed/overturned legislation. It violates the core duty of honesty and candour to the tribunal.
